summary: The reviewed code and retained QC evidence support morphology-neutral retention of technically valid short and single-slice observations, specimen-level sensitivity reporting, and reconciliation of technical-valid versus reconstructed counts. Conditional acceptance remains warranted because length alone cannot distinguish genuine short nuclei from fragments, and independent biological adjudication of short, terminal, and single-slice cases is not retained.

findings.title: Short-track biological identity is not independently adjudicated
findings.impact: The workflow transparently retains below-2-um tracks, but some may be fragments or noise; without independent biological review, retention demonstrates neutrality rather than biological correctness for each track.
evidence: audits/claims_registry.json:168 lists the unresolved distinction between genuine short nuclei and fragments as a known limitation.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/morphology_warning_proportions.csv shows approximately 18% below-2-um technical-valid observations in each retained representative specimen.
findings.recommendation: Add blinded adjudication or independent visual evidence for short, terminal optical-section, fragment-like, and single-slice cases, while preserving all technically valid tracks in the primary population.

findings.title: Retained evidence is execution-focused rather than population-wide biological validation
findings.impact: The current artifacts support reproducibility and sensitivity accounting but do not establish that short-track behavior is biologically representative across all specimens or genotypes.
evidence: audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:74-75 limits the representative evidence to execution and provenance and states that it does not establish a biological group effect.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:7-9 records 35 specimen rows but only 2 included complete specimens.
findings.recommendation: Repeat the specimen-level sensitivity artifact across the complete eligible specimen set before making biological conclusions from short-track prevalence or sensitivity.

limitations: No full stack was run, per instruction.
The review did not independently adjudicate raw short-track masks or cross-slice identities.
Length below 2 um is not itself evidence of biological identity or technical noise.
Only two complete representative specimens are retained in the reviewed acceptance artifact.
recommended_follow_up: Obtain independent biological review of short, single-slice, terminal, and fragment-like observations.
Preserve the single primary technical-valid population and continue reporting specimen-level sensitivity as descriptive QC.
